question.text: For a PMS distributor, the RELEVANT regulatory framework is:

answer.text: SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020, with APMI circulars and registration compliance

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS distributors are governed by the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020, and must comply with circulars and registration requirements issued by APMI (the Association of Portfolio Managers in India). SEBI is the regulator; APMI handles the distributor registration and circulars layer. The Trap: RBI Master Directions govern banks and NBFCs, not PMS distribution. IRDAI regulates insurance distribution, and PFRDA regulates pension products — none of these apply to PMS distributors. Note: Stem reworded to "regulatory framework" and the keyed option expanded to name the regulation plus APMI circulars and registration compliance.
